result.stdout:
USAGE:
    sqlxl [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help    Prints help information

COMMANDS:
    init             Connect to a SQL Server database, install SqlXL            
                     infrastructure, and save the connection profile            
    use <PROFILE>    Set the active connection profile (e.g. sqlxl use prod)    
    connections      Manage saved connection profiles                           
    insert           Generate an INSERT template or import a filled template    
                     into a table                                               
    update           Generate an UPDATE template pre-populated with existing    
                     rows, or import a filled template                          
    import           Generate a template or import data via a custom            
                     BulkOpFeature (--feature N)                                
    export           Export SQL query results to Excel (requires sqlxl init)    
    test             Auto-generate and run test data against all configured     
                     features for a table                                       
    infer <INPUT>    Read an Excel file and emit a CREATE TABLE statement       
                     inferred from the data                                     
    demo             Create the SqlXlDemo database with sample data (drops and  
                     recreates)

result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Generate an INSERT template or import a filled template into a table

USAGE:
    sqlxl insert [OPTIONS]

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help                    Prints help information                       
        --connection <CONNSTR>    SQL Server connection string (overrides saved 
                                  profile)                                      
        --profile <NAME>          Named connection profile to use (overrides    
                                  active profile)                               
        --table <TABLE>           Domain table to target, e.g. dbo.Products or  
                                  just Products (assumes dbo)                   
        --file <FILE>             Excel file to import. Omit to generate an     
                                  empty INSERT template instead                 
        --output <FILE>           Output path for generated template (optional; 
                                  defaults to TableName_insert_YYYYMMDD.xlsx)   
        --no-launch               Do not open the generated Excel file (useful  
                                  for agents and scripts)

        --table <TABLE>           Domain table to target, e.g. dbo.Products or

                                  defaults to TableName_update_YYYYMMDD.xlsx)   
        --no-launch               Do not open the generated Excel file (useful  
                                  for agents and scripts)

result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Read an Excel file and emit a CREATE TABLE statement inferred from the data

USAGE:
    sqlxl infer <INPUT> [OPTIONS]

ARGUMENTS:
    <INPUT>    Path to the .xlsx file to infer schema from

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help                            Prints help information               
        --table <NAME>                    Target table name (default: sanitized 
                                          file basename)                        
        --schema <NAME>                   Target schema name (default: dbo)     
        --sheet <NAME>                    Worksheet to read (required when      
                                          workbook has more than one sheet)     
        --sample-size <N>                 Number of data rows to sample         
                                          (default: 1000)                       
        --confidence-threshold <RATIO>    Min valid-ratio for a type to be      
                                          selected (default: 0.9)               
        --mode <MODE>                     permissive (invalid → NULL) or strict 
                                          (any invalid forces NVARCHAR fallback)
        --max-varchar <N>                 Cap for inferred NVARCHAR length      
                                          (default: 255)                        
        --date-format <STYLE>             us (M/d/yyyy + ISO + long forms) or   
                                          iso (ISO + long forms only). Default: 
                                          us                                    
        --output <PATH>                   Write generated DDL to a file         
                                          (default: stdout)                     
        --report <PATH>                   Write a JSON inference report to this 
                                          path (optional)
